C094.name: Singida Municipal Council
C094.documented: drought on the central plateau, strong winds, wildfire, flash floods, and water shortage

area.en: Singida Municipal: lakeside town and rocky hills
area.sw: Manispaa ya Singida: mji wa kando ya maziwa na milima ya mawe

risk.en: This area is a dry town between the Singidani and Kindai lakes and rocky hills, where storm run-off floods low streets, lakes rise in wet years and water is scarce in the dry season.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji kame kati ya maziwa ya Singidani na Kindai na milima ya mawe, ambapo maji ya dhoruba hufurika mitaa ya chini, maziwa hujaa katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na maji ni haba wakati wa kiangazi.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build away from lake margins and gullies, keep drains open and harvest and store water safely. What raises the risk in both wet and dry months: building on the lake margins or at the gully mouths, filling the drains with waste, and leaving water standing in open containers after the rains. Know the higher street away from the lakes and gullies that your household will move to when storm run-off rises, and agree early where water will come from when the town supply runs short in the dry season. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na kingo za maziwa na makorongo, kuweka mitaro wazi na kuvuna na kuhifadhi maji kwa usalama. Kinachoongeza hatari katika miezi ya mvua na ya kiangazi: kujenga kwenye kingo za maziwa au midomo ya makorongo, kujaza mitaro taka, na kuacha maji yakituama kwenye vyombo wazi baada ya mvua. Fahamu mtaa wa juu mbali na maziwa na makorongo ambao kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapopanda, na kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi maji ya mji yanapopungua wakati wa kiangazi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C097.name: Ikungi District Council
C097.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.sw: Ikungi: mashamba kame na barabara kuu

risk.en: This area is semi-arid farmland where droughts and dry spells fail crops, and flash floods cross the Dodoma–Singida highway.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mashamba kame kiasi ambapo ukame na vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao, na mafuriko ya ghafla hupita barabara kuu ya Dodoma–Singida.

advice.en: For those farming and travelling here, it helps to plant sorghum, millet and sunflower, keep food reserves and never cross flowing water on the road. What raises the loss and to the danger: relying on maize alone, selling the whole harvest at once, cutting the remaining trees for charcoal when money is short and driving or walking through flowing water on the highway. Agree early, as a household and a village, where food and water will come from in a failed season, and act before the stores are empty; on the road, wait for the water to drop rather than cross. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kusafiri hapa, ni vyema kupanda mtama, uwele na alizeti, kuweka akiba ya chakula na kutovuka kamwe maji yanayotiririka barabarani. Kinachoongeza hasara na hatari: kutegemea mahindi pekee, kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja, kukata miti iliyobaki kwa mkaa pesa zinapopungua na kupita kwa gari au kwa miguu kwenye maji yanayotiririka barabara kuu. Kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na kijiji, chakula na maji vitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana, na chukueni hatua kabla akiba haijaisha; barabarani, subirini maji yapungue badala ya kuvuka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C092.name: Iramba District Council
C092.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.en: Iramba: escarpment, Lake Kitangiri and gold pits
area.sw: Iramba: mteremko, Ziwa Kitangiri na mashimo ya dhahabu

risk.en: This area has the Rift escarpment where heavy rain cuts gullies, Lake Kitangiri margins that flood, and artisanal gold pits that collapse in the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mteremko wa Bonde la Ufa ambapo mvua kubwa huchimba makorongo, kingo za Ziwa Kitangiri zinazofurika, na mashimo madogo ya dhahabu yanayobomoka wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living and mining here, it helps to build away from gully edges, keep homes above lake flood lines and fence or backfill pits. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the escarpment, building on the Kitangiri margins, digging pits without timbering and working them while rain is falling. Know the firm ground away from the gullies and above the lake that your household will move to when heavy rain sets in on the escarpment, and keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo, kujenga juu ya mistari ya mafuriko ya ziwa na kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye mwinuko, kujenga kwenye kingo za Kitangiri, kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili na kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na makorongo na juu ya ziwa ambalo kaya yako itahamia mvua kubwa inapoanza mwinukoni, na mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C096.name: Itigi District Council
C096.documented: drought, Itigi thicket wildfire, strong winds, and flash floods

area.en: Itigi: thicket, railway and dry farmland
area.sw: Itigi: vichaka, reli na mashamba kame

risk.en: This area has dense Itigi thicket and dry farmland on the Central Line, where droughts fail crops and dry-season fires spread.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vichaka vizito vya Itigi na mashamba kame kando ya Reli ya Kati, ambapo ukame huharibu mazao na moto wa kiangazi husambaa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to grow drought-tolerant crops, keep fire breaks and stay off the railway line during floods. What raises the risk: burning fields or charcoal in the thicket on windy days, relying on maize alone, and walking or driving across the railway culverts while water is running. Know the cleared open ground your household will move to if a thicket fire comes towards the houses, and agree early where food and water will come from in a failed season. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kukaa mbali na reli wakati wa mafuriko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma mashamba au mkaa kwenye kichaka siku za upepo, kutegemea mahindi pekee, na kutembea au kupita kwa gari kwenye makalavati ya reli maji yakitiririka. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto wa kichakani ukielekea nyumbani, na kubalianeni mapema chakula na maji vitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C095.name: Manyoni District Council
C095.documented: drought, wildfire, strong winds, flash floods, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Manyoni: dry plains, Bahi swamp edge and railway
area.sw: Manyoni: tambarare kame, pembezoni mwa bwawa la Bahi na reli

risk.en: This area has dry plains where drought hits crops and livestock, low areas that flood around the Bahi swamp edge, and the Central Line and highway.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare kame ambapo ukame huathiri mazao na mifugo, maeneo ya chini yanayofurika pembezoni mwa bwawa la Bahi, na Reli ya Kati na barabara kuu.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to store water and fodder, keep homes off swamp margins and plan travel around floods. What raises the risk and to the loss: building permanent houses and stores on the Bahi swamp edge, keeping more animals than the dry-season water points can serve, and crossing the flooded road and rail culverts. Know the raised ground your village will move to when the swamp spreads, and agree early where the herds and the families will go for water and pasture in a dry year; move before the animals weaken. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kuhifadhi maji na malisho, kujenga nje ya kingo za bwawa na kupanga safari kuzingatia mafuriko. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara: kujenga nyumba na maghala ya kudumu kwenye kingo za bwawa la Bahi, kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko vyanzo vya maji vya kiangazi vinavyoweza kuhudumia, na kuvuka makalavati ya barabara na reli yaliyofurika. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia bwawa linapotanuka, na kubalianeni mapema mifugo na familia zitaenda wapi kupata maji na malisho mwaka wa ukame; hamieni kabla mifugo haijadhoofika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C098.name: Mkalama District Council
C098.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.en: Mkalama: Lake Eyasi basin and Wembere plains
area.sw: Mkalama: bonde la Ziwa Eyasi na tambarare za Wembere

risk.en: This area has dry basin land where droughts are frequent, clay plains that flood in wet years and conflicts between farmers and herders over water.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina ardhi kame ya bonde ambapo ukame ni wa mara kwa mara, tambarare za mfinyanzi zinazofurika katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na migogoro kati ya wakulima na wafugaji kuhusu maji.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to follow village land-use plans, protect water points and keep household food reserves. What raises the loss and to the quarrels in a dry year: building homes on the clay plains that flood, keeping more animals than the dry-season pasture can carry, driving herds onto cropped fields and cutting fields across the livestock routes. Agree early, between farmers and herders, where the herds will water and the families will find food in a failed season, and settle it before the dry months; in wet years, know the raised ground your household will move to when the plains flood. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi ya vijiji, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hasara na migogoro mwaka wa ukame: kujenga nyumba kwenye tambarare za udongo wa mfinyanzi zinazofurika, kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko malisho ya kiangazi yanavyoweza kubeba, kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao na kulima kuvuka njia za mifugo. Kubalianeni mapema, wakulima na wafugaji, mifugo itanyweshwa wapi na familia zitapata wapi chakula msimu ukikosekana, na maamuzi yafanyike kabla ya miezi ya kiangazi; miaka ya mvua nyingi, fahamu eneo lililoinuka ambalo kaya yako itahamia tambarare zinapofurika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C093.name: Singida District Council
C093.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.en: Singida DC: dry farmland and seasonal lakes
area.sw: Singida DC: mashamba kame na maziwa ya msimu

risk.en: This area has dry farmland and seasonal lakes where droughts fail crops, strong winds raise dust and lakes flood fields in wet years.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba kame na maziwa ya msimu ambapo ukame huharibu mazao, upepo mkali huinua vumbi na maziwa hufurika mashamba katika miaka ya mvua nyingi.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to grow drought-tolerant crops, plant windbreaks and keep homes above lake flood lines. What raises the loss and to the danger: relying on maize alone, ploughing the sandy soils bare so the wind strips them, cutting the remaining trees for charcoal and building on the seasonal lake beds because they look dry. Agree early where food and water will come from in a failed season and act before the stores are empty; in wet years, know the higher ground your household will move to when the lakes spread over the fields. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kupanda mistari ya miti ya kuzuia upepo na kujenga juu ya mistari ya mafuriko ya maziwa. Kinachoongeza hasara na hatari: kutegemea mahindi pekee, kulima udongo wa mchanga hadi kuwa tupu upepo ukauchukue, kukata miti iliyobaki kwa mkaa na kujenga kwenye sakafu za maziwa ya msimu kwa sababu zinaonekana kavu. Kubalianeni mapema chakula na maji vitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana na chukueni hatua kabla akiba haijaisha; miaka ya mvua nyingi, fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia maziwa yanapotapakaa mashambani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
